column1: # ADR-0111, George 2026-10-02 ("Accept it"): skins left out of
# each pack because another copy of the same skin draws the metadata as well
# or better. Reviewed on rendered contact sheets; every row names the copy kept.
# Names are upstream's (before any rename). assemble.py fails on a row that
# matches no skin, so a moved pin cannot silently keep a duplicate.
# Classes: a = renders identically; a-lb = letterboxed copy of a native one;
# a-near = Gelo5's skin and the catalog's revision, both correct, text placed
# a little differently (Gelo5's kept); b = the removed copy draws the metadata
